one_line: A 45-second re-captioned cinematic short film (mothers at a school gate find their kids covered in mud, then learn the kids were helping an elderly man) narrated only by burned-in text blocks, with a permanent 'Comment FKC' lead-magnet banner underneath.

hook.visual: A woman in a striped tee and white trousers waits at a school gate, looking up and around (0-4 s); at 4 s children run out toward the adults. Footage sits in a letterboxed band in the middle of a 9:16 black canvas.
hook.on_screen_text: A school tested parents: mothers waiting for their children found them covered in mud. 👉 (A "test" they never saw coming) (English on screen; no translation needed)
hook.why_it_stops_the_scroll: Inferred: the caption block states the situation in one sentence and adds a bracketed teaser ('a test they never saw coming'), which opens two loops at once (why are the kids muddy, what was the test). The text is readable with sound off and the first shot is a calm, human face waiting, so the viewer wants to see what happens when the kids arrive.

beats.observed: Mother in striped tee waiting at a school gate, looks up then sideways (0-2 s); wide shot of her walking with a white van and painted wall behind, a child in the right of frame running out (4 s). Text block 1 sits in a black band above the footage; the CTA banner sits in a black band below.
beats.spoken: No speech. Transcript only marks [MUSIC] from 0 to 10 s.
beats.on_screen_text: A school tested parents: mothers waiting for their children found them covered in mud. 👉 (A "test" they never saw coming) | Comment FKC for Future-Ready Kids Checklist 👇👇👇

beats.observed: A child with a backpack stands next to the mother who looks down at the child (6 s); a smiling girl with a dirt-smudged face (8 s); close-up of a mother with a distressed, scolding expression (10 s).
beats.on_screen_text: At first, the mothers assumed the mess was just from reckless, careless play.

beats.observed: A mother covers her face with both hands while a child's hand reaches in from the left (12 s); a mother in a blue top speaks and presses her hand to her chest (14 s); a wall-mounted screen showing a boy with a label reading 'STUDENT OF [unclear, cut off]' (16 s). Mothers react, then the screen appears.
beats.spoken: No speech transcribed in this stretch (no marker between 10 and 30 s).
beats.on_screen_text: The mothers were frustrated. Then, a screen turned on and revealed the truth...

beats.observed: The screen footage plays inside the film: an elderly person close to green foliage (18 s); a tipped wheelbarrow churning in mud (20 s); an elderly man with the overturned wheelbarrow and scattered plant pots (22 s, 26 s); a girl in school uniform with pigtails nearby (24 s).
beats.on_screen_text: The footage shows the children got dirty while helping an old man whose plant pot fell in the mud.

beats.observed: Girl and mother smiling at each other close up (28 s); a boy's shirt and shorts stained with mud (30 s); a boy and the elderly man carrying plant pots across wet pavement (32 s).
beats.on_screen_text: The mothers realize the stains came from a place of kindness, not mischief.

beats.observed: A mother speaking to camera with a softened expression (34 s); a boy in a white tee with blue backpack running on grass (36 s); the boy carrying a clay pot (38 s).
beats.on_screen_text: Frustration instantly turns into deep pride for their children's character.

beats.observed: Mother hugging a boy, both smiling (40 s); mother smiling with a girl in a pink hair bow (42 s); mother laughing, head down (44 s). The CTA banner stays on screen to the last frame.
beats.on_screen_text: The mud washes out. But the kindness and strength they showed will stay forever. | Comment FKC for Future-Ready Kids Checklist 👇👇👇

payoff: The reason for the mud is revealed at about 20 to 26 s (children helping an elderly man whose plant pots fell in mud); the emotional release (mothers' pride, hugs) lands from about 28 s to the end at 45 s. Block boundaries are accurate to about plus or minus 2 s because frames were sampled every 2 s.
cta: Persistent bottom banner for the full 45 s: 'Comment FKC for Future-Ready Kids Checklist' (👇👇👇). The caption repeats it and says the checklist builds confidence, resilience and adaptability habits. This is a comment-keyword lead magnet (inferred: delivered by DM).
share_or_comment_trigger: Inferred: parents share this because it flips a common irritation (my child came home filthy) into pride, and the moral is easy to say in one line ('look for the heart behind the messy behavior'). Comments are triggered only by the keyword gate, which is weakly tied to the story.
why_it_worked: Misjudge-then-reveal arc with two open loops in the first caption ('a test', 'covered in mud') and a second loop at 12 to 18 s ('a screen turned on and revealed the truth...'); 3.38M views on an account median of 117,551 is 28.8x.
Emotion did the work: a 7.57% like rate (256,268 likes) is far above what the other two videos in this batch earned, consistent with a feel-good story people tap on at the end (inferred).

Story is told entirely in short text blocks of one sentence each, so it plays with sound off and each block gives a new reason to stay; only 1,914 comments (0.06% of views), so the lead-magnet gate is a weak driver here compared with the likes.
paid_signal: no: like_rate_pct is 7.57, nowhere near the under-0.3 paid pattern, and the engagement is skewed to likes, which fits organic virality. Boosting cannot be ruled out from the data.

solo_route.how: 1) Write a 6-block caption script in the same arc: situation + teaser, wrong assumption, 'then [camera/photo/note] revealed the truth...', the reveal, the feeling flip, one-line moral (one sentence per block, about 6 s each). 2) Make 8 to 10 shots with an AI image-to-video tool (Veo, Kling or Runway style) using one fixed character reference, or reuse LumeBook's own AI-illustrated child-hero book pages with slow CapCut zooms (a muddy hero helping an elderly neighbour). 3) In CapCut set a 9:16 black canvas, put the clips in a middle band, a white sans-serif caption block above that changes every 5 to 7 s, and a fixed 'Comment [keyword] for [free book preview]' banner below for the whole video, plus licensed music. 4) Set the keyword to auto-reply with the free preview link.
solo_route.needs: Nothing for the AI route besides an AI video tool and a comment-to-DM automation. Do not re-upload the original footage: it is someone else's film, so only repost with the rights holder's permission (source not credited in this post).

lumebook_version.hook_he: הילד חזר מהגן מלא בוץ. עד שהאמא ראתה למה.
lumebook_version.concept: A 40 to 45 second AI-illustrated micro-story with the same caption-only narration: a child hero comes home covered in mud, the parent assumes mischief, a photo or neighbour reveals the child was helping someone, ending on a one-line moral about kindness. The permanent banner offers a free personalised preview of the child as the hero of their own kindness story.

evidence_notes: Observed: all sheets (0 to 44 s) and single frames at 0 s and 16 s; on-screen English text read directly from frames; the CTA banner is present in every frame. Spoken: whisper.srt contains only [MUSIC] markers at 0-10 s and 30-40 s, so there is no usable speech transcript and no spoken claims are cited. Repost judgement is inferred: the footage is a polished multi-location narrative film with several actors, the account is a parenting printables brand, the caption says 'I love how this story reminds us...' without crediting a source, and the clip is letterboxed with added text and CTA bands. No creator handle or watermark was visible at sheet resolution (small corner marks could be missed), so the original producer is unverified. Frame at 18 s shows an elderly person partly hidden by foliage; the caption block says 'old man', which I rely on for the 22 and 26 s frames. The label on the screen at 16 s is cut off after 'STUDENT OF'. The 'FKC' meaning (Future-Ready Kids Checklist) comes from on-screen text. Caption block timings are plus or minus 2 s.
